decisions.reason: The LED track spotlight sits close to the firm's established system offer and is presented on its own page, and the industry's turnover is growing, so there is no performance shortfall against aspirations that would trigger problemistic search, while slack from a broad product range lets the firm carry it through early uncertainty.

The LED ceiling luminaire is a core-adjacent addition launched only recently, and with industry growth and no signs of difficulty, performance appears to meet aspirations, so management would keep it rather than redirect its resources.
